verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a batch endpoint that submits multiple events in one request, and its syncs act on many rows per run, sending only added, changed, or removed rows via CDC. That is real bulk handling of data records, but nothing shows bulk actions across workspace resources such as syncs, audiences, or models, and nothing shows the MCP server or AI agent acting on many items at once. missing for 10: documented bulk operations on workspace resources (e.g. bulk trigger/edit/delete syncs or audiences), bulk actions via MCP/AI agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use the batch endpoint to submit multiple events to the collector in a single request.
Hightouch uses change data capture to compare the current model results against the previous run and send only the rows that were added, changed, or removed.
